Title: Group Targeting for Non-Azure Servers in Azure Update Management

Body.Content:
Azure Update Management has released a new feature for public preview. Group targeting for non-Azure servers enables you to create dynamically resolved periodic update deployments for non-Azure servers. This new feature enables:

  • Targeting of non-Azure servers based on Log Analytics saved searches.
  • Dynamic resolution of the target servers for an update deployment. Once the update deployment is created, any new non-Azure servers added to update management which meet the search criteria will be automatically picked up in the next deployment run without the user having to modify the update deployment itself.

Learn more about non-Azure group targeting for Azure update management.
